invariant.name: unique_query_typed_conflict_free_physical_row_admission_and_one_to_one_reconciliation_before_quota
steps: materialize plaintext candidates unchanged before structured admission
deduplicate structured observations by physical source/page/table/row/column identity
group structured cells into physical row inventories
retain only normalized metric-compatible cells for typed role/period slots requested by compile_question_plan
fail closed when any requested slot is claimed by more than one physical row or has multiple exact Decimal values
require exactly one complete physical row inventory for all requested slots
fail closed on a typed plaintext value conflict
reconcile a structured/plaintext equivalent only for a unique source/page/metric/role/period/exact-Decimal mapping
overlay identity on the unique plaintext representative without changing relevance/order/value
admit unmatched structured cells only from the unique complete conflict-free row before the unchanged quota
